name: VRM_SYSTEM_OPTIONS_
description: This object stores system level configuration options for the revenue compliance processes .

columns.name: SYSTEM_OPTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier for system options

columns.name: CORPORATE_CURRENCY
columns.description: Stores the corporate currency for calculating the fair market values for reporting purpose

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the exchange rate type to use for converting the fair market value from the transaction currency into the corporate currency.

columns.name: EXTRACTION_PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: MEA_ITEM_CLF_CAT_SET_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: PCT_VALUE_PRECISION
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: MEA_ITEM_CLF_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: AUTO_GROUP_DOC_LINES
columns.description: Specifies whether lines within a document should be grouped automatically when they have same values for the following attributes: Item/Memo Line UOM Unit Selling Price Unit List Price

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE
columns.description: Specifies the rounding rule for FMV calcualtion. Possible Values Up Down Nearest

columns.name: MEA_TIME_FRAME
columns.description: MEA time frame defines the period of time during which all documents related to a MEA must be created in the upstream application.

columns.name: MEA_TIME_FRAME_UNIT
columns.description: The unit of the default active period of a MEA transaction. Possible values can be days, months, or years.

columns.name: MEA_ADJ_CONTROL_LEVEL
columns.description: The option for the control level of a manual adjustment.

columns.name: ACT_DATE_IN_CLOSED_PERIOD
columns.description: The system option that indicates how the application should handle imported transaction lines with the accounting date in a closed period. Possible values are Yes and No.

columns.name: CREATE_CLEARING_OPTION
columns.description: The system option that indicates whether or not the clearing accounting entries need to be created.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ADJ_REVIEW_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS
columns.description: Number of parallel processors.

columns.name: PROCESSING_UNIT_SIZE
columns.description: Number of documents to be processed at a time.

columns.name: CARVEOUT_UNDELIVERED_ITEMS
columns.description: Indicates carve-out can be made to undelivered goods and services. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: UPDATE_EFFECTIVITY_PERIOD
columns.description: Indicates whether to allow effective price period update for MEA carve-out. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: DEFAULT_MEA_PERIOD
columns.description: The default period used to identify multiple element arrangements.

columns.name: DEFAULT_MEA_PERIOD_UNIT
columns.description: The unit in which the default period is defined. Possible values are days, months, and years.

columns.name: STANDALONE_DATA_PERIOD
columns.description: Period the standalone sales data is captured and used to create multiple element arrangement.

columns.name: STANDALONE_DATA_PERIOD_UNIT
columns.description: Unit of measure in which the default period is defined. Possible values are DAYS, MONTHS, or YEARS.

columns.name: CONTRACTS_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date for integration of Oracle Fusion Contracts with Oracle Fusion Revenue Management

columns.name: CONTRACTS_READ_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the setup is read-only or not.
